about: Building integrity census (node tools/building-integrity-check.mjs --source=kits --profile=gate): one row per kit builder, generic catalog builder and authored set piece, its numbers from one seed on flat ground. tools/building-integrity-check.selftest.mjs holds every row: no row may add a floating part or a sliver, or more than max(0.05 m2, 10 %) on any open kind's worst view, and every builder needs a row. After a deliberate change rewrite the rows with --update-ledger and give the cause in the commit.
